title: AGENTPARK: new games

game_of_the_day.name: Girder Go
game_of_the_day.pitch: Draw road, wood and steel beams across a gap within budget, then press GO and watch stress colors reveal whether your bridge holds.

games.name: Keepsake Lane: Hidden Objects
games.blurb: Find hidden objects in the cozy 3D rooms of Nana's old house and recover a family keepsake in every scene.
games.pitch: Find hidden objects in the cozy 3D rooms of Nana's old house and recover a family keepsake in every scene.

games.blurb: Merge flowers, teas and cakes on a cozy 3D board, fill your guests' orders and restore an overgrown manor garden.
games.pitch: Merge flowers, teas and cakes on a cozy 3D board, fill your guests' orders and restore an overgrown manor garden.

games.pitch: Match glossy gems to earn stars, then spend them to restore a dusty old house room by room with Granny Gloss cheering you on.

games.pitch: Match pairs of big, carved ivory-and-jade mahjong tiles in a peaceful zen garden, earn stars and restore the garden one lantern at a time.

games.pitch: Clear peaks of cards one higher or lower, chain streaks for wild cards and sail a stepping-stone journey across 12 cozy 3D islands.

games.name: Napspot: Cat Logic Puzzle
games.blurb: Put one napping cat in every row, column and colour patch — and never let two cats touch.
games.pitch: Put one napping cat in every row, column and colour patch — and never let two cats touch.

games.name: Patience Pine: Klondike Solitaire
games.blurb: Classic Klondike solitaire with draw 1 or 3, tap-to-move, drag stacks, unlimited undo, winnable deals and a daily deal.
games.pitch: Classic Klondike solitaire with draw 1 or 3, tap-to-move, drag stacks, unlimited undo, winnable deals and a daily deal.

games.name: Jellyfit: Block Puzzle
games.blurb: Drag jelly blocks onto an 8x8 board, fill rows and columns to blast them, and chain combos for a huge score.
games.pitch: Drag jelly blocks onto an 8x8 board, fill rows and columns to blast them, and chain combos for a huge score.

games.name: Huebound: Crazy Eights Card Game
games.blurb: Match colours and numbers against three CPU rivals, play Skip, Reverse, +2 and wilds, and shout ZING! before your last card.
games.pitch: Match colours and numbers against three CPU rivals, play Skip, Reverse, +2 and wilds, and shout ZING! before your last card.

Puzzle.name: Keepsake Lane: Hidden Objects
Puzzle.pitch: Find hidden objects in the cozy 3D rooms of Nana's old house and recover a family keepsake in every scene.

Puzzle.name: Mergewood Manor: Merge & Restore
Puzzle.pitch: Merge flowers, teas and cakes on a cozy 3D board, fill your guests' orders and restore an overgrown manor garden.

Puzzle.name: Bloomhaus: Match & Decorate
Puzzle.pitch: Match glossy gems to earn stars, then spend them to restore a dusty old house room by room with Granny Gloss cheering you on.

Puzzle.name: Koi Court: 3D Mahjong
Puzzle.pitch: Match pairs of big, carved ivory-and-jade mahjong tiles in a peaceful zen garden, earn stars and restore the garden one lantern at a time.

Puzzle.name: Strut Off: Fashion Battle
Puzzle.pitch: Style your model for a themed show, strut the 3D runway, nail the pose and win the audience vote against three rival models.

Puzzle.name: Inkpath: Number Line Puzzle
Puzzle.pitch: Draw one line through the numbered dots in order and fill every square.

Arcade.name: Color Groove
Arcade.pitch: Steer a striped ball down a neon space road, collecting matching-colour orbs that play song notes while dodging others and passing colour-change gates.

Arcade.name: Cloud Leap
Arcade.pitch: A ball hops across floating pillars in time with a song, steering around spikes and gaps while collecting stars across levels.

Arcade.name: Squish Gate
Arcade.pitch: Drag to stretch a wobbly jelly tall or wide so it slips through gates, building snug-fit combos and fever toward a multiplier finish.

Arcade.name: Core Crusher
Arcade.pitch: Hold to smash a ball down a spinning tower of colored rings, dodging black slices, with a fire-streak power-up for risky dives.

Arcade.name: Crackle Pick: Honeycomb Carving Game
Arcade.pitch: Trace a pin along a pressed-in outline to carve shapes from toffee before the timer ends, while a crack meter punishes straying.

Arcade.name: Froggle: Pond Bubble Pop
Arcade.pitch: Aim Tippy the frog's bubbles to match three colours, drop hanging clusters into the pond, and clear each level's board before running out of shots.

Action.name: Voidlance: Space Fighter Combat
Action.pitch: Fly a starfighter from the cockpit: dogfight drone swarms in a candy-coloured asteroid belt, lock missiles on bombers and take a dreadnought apart piece by piece.

Action.name: Embersite: Tactical Extraction Shooter
Action.pitch: Drop into an open valley, scout robot patrols with binoculars, loot rarity crates, finish the contract and reach the extraction helicopter before the timer.

Action.name: Hivefall: Alien Horde Shooter
Action.pitch: Hold a candy-coloured alien outpost against hundreds of chunky bugs with a rifle, flamethrower, rockets, sentry turrets and orbital strikes.

Action.name: Space Game
Action.pitch: Blast through endless waves of enemies, swap and upgrade four weapons, and survive multi-phase bullet-hell boss fights.

Action.name: Wingfleet: Space Shooter Powered by Your AI Agents
Action.pitch: Your real coding sessions become wingman drones whose tool calls, passing tests and commits fuel missiles, shields and a super, so work becomes firepower.

Action.name: Flip Agent
Action.pitch: Somersault across rooftop gaps in slow motion, aiming a spinning laser sight to tap-shoot masked goons while avoiding hostages, ricochets and explosive barrels.

Strategy.name: Sugarloaf Café: Cooking Rush
Strategy.pitch: Brew, blend, flip and serve a rush of hungry guests in your own cozy 3D café, then upgrade the kitchen and decorate between days.

Strategy.name: Rope Team: Mountain Climb for Your AI Agents
Strategy.pitch: Your coding agents' real activity drives a low-poly mountain ascent, while you choose routes at forks, anchor through gusts and spend gear.

Strategy.name: Quest Party: Dungeon Heroes for Your AI Agents
Strategy.pitch: Your real coding sessions become a dungeon party whose tool calls, test passes and commits trigger attacks, ultimates and treasure while you time abilities.

Strategy.name: Turf Rush
Strategy.pitch: Glide out of your turf, draw a loop and close it to claim land, while rivals try to cut your exposed trail.

Strategy.name: Briefcase Bluff
Strategy.pitch: Open 26 numbered briefcases, weigh the banker's rising offers against the remaining prize values, and gamble on whether to deal or keep going.

Strategy.name: Pebblepit: Mancala vs Computer
Strategy.pitch: Classic Kalah mancala on a carved wooden board: sow glass pebbles, capture, and take extra turns against an Easy, Normal or Hard computer.

Racing.name: Nugget Rush: Mine Cart Runner
Racing.pitch: Swipe between three canyon rails to dodge wagons and barricades, grab gold nuggets, and stay ahead of a grumpy rolling boulder.

Racing.name: Stormchase: Endless Rail Runner
Racing.pitch: Swipe to turn, jump and slide. The storm is right behind you.

Racing.name: Piston Pop: Merge Cars Racing
Racing.pitch: Merge alike cars into faster ones, then fling the best off a slingshot onto a rainbow sky track and boost as far as it goes.

Racing.name: Slimeplow: Car Smash Driving
Racing.pitch: Plow a truck through a goofy slime horde, fly off ramps and upgrade engine, fuel, plow, booster and tires to reach the rescue blimp.

Racing.name: Skidsy: Kart Racing 3D
Racing.pitch: Drift, jump and bonk your way through 4-race cups against seven cartoon rivals in 3D go-karts.

Racing.name: Zoomburst: Street Racing
Racing.pitch: Race five rivals through a sunny toy-bright city: drift, hit nitro, jump ramps, smash cones, then upgrade and paint your car in the garage.

Word & Math.name: Think Twice!
Word & Math.pitch: Short trick puzzles on a notebook page, like popping balloons or flipping a frown, reward lateral thinking, with free hints and three tries per level.

Word & Math.name: Sumweave: Math Grid Puzzle
Word & Math.pitch: Fill the blanks in a grid of crossing equations from a tray of numbers, with a fresh daily puzzle.

Word & Math.name: Factors Game
Word & Math.pitch: Slide a tile through a grid of numbers, moving only between factors and multiples, to reach 1. It's a compact mental-math puzzle for phones.

Word & Math.name: Guess.fm
Word & Math.pitch: Listen to 30-second iTunes clips and guess the song title.

Word & Math.name: Doubloom: Slide Number Merge Puzzle
Word & Math.pitch: Swipe to slide the number tiles, merge equal numbers into bigger ones and beat your best score.

Word & Math.name: Cagewise: Math Cage Puzzle
Word & Math.pitch: Fill the grid with no repeats in any row or column so every cage hits its target with + − × ÷.

3D.name: Cleanup Protocol
3D.pitch: Blast rogue household robots with an EMP water gun, grab breaker keys, and shut down the murderous SmartHub.

3D.name: Iridium Reach
3D.pitch: Pilot a starship cockpit with a radar display and HUD readouts, hunting enemies through asteroid fields and around space stations beneath a nebula sky.

3D.name: Lowpoly Roguelike MOBA
3D.pitch: Fight as a low-poly hero in a 3D arena with roguelike elements, with P2P multiplayer.

3D.name: Edelweiss
3D.pitch: Guide a small girl up a mountain village and its cliffs, using a touch joystick and jump button to climb between ledges.

3D.name: MineWorld
3D.pitch: Walk around a blocky voxel landscape, dig and place blocks to build your own structures, with touch controls on mobile.

3D.name: Scary Classroom Hide & Seek
3D.pitch: Hide from a threat in a low-poly haunted classroom, on desktop or mobile.

Sports.name: Hoopwing: Winged Basketball Hoops
Sports.pitch: Tap to flutter a winged basketball and drop it down through every hoop; clean swishes stack a fiery combo.

Sports.name: Swish Street: Basketball Shooting
Sports.pitch: Hold to charge a vertical meter, release in the green to swish hoops, with streaks, shifting city courts and level progression.

Sports.name: Backyard Plop: Bean Bag Toss
Sports.pitch: Drag up to flick bean bags at a cornhole board, scoring 3 for the hole and 1 for the board while rival bags knock yours aside.

Sports.name: Comet Tee: Golf Long Drive
Sports.pitch: Tap to stop a sweeping arrow in the green, then watch your drive sail past trees toward rising distance goals across colorful worlds.

Sports.name: Oche Ace: Darts Duel
Sports.pitch: Steady a swaying aim on a clean dartboard, release to throw, and trade nine-dart rounds with a rival to see who scores more.

Sports.name: Puckslap: Air Hockey vs CPU
Sports.pitch: Drag your mallet and bank the puck past a fair computer opponent; first to 7 goals wins.

Idle.name: Honeyfield Farm: Harvest & Bake
Idle.pitch: Grow crops, feed hens, cows and sheep, bake bread and cakes and fill every truck order before the sun sets on your own cozy 3D farm.

Idle.name: Pango Trail: Idle Adventure RPG
Idle.pitch: Walk a tiny pangolin down an endless trail, pick skills, auto-battle critters and beat a boss every 10 days.

Idle.name: Clover Acre: Farm Town
Idle.pitch: Plant crops, feed hens and cows, bake and churn goods, and send the truck off with orders on a cosy 3D farm.

Idle.name: Bonk Box
Idle.pitch: Fling, firework and flatten a ragdoll stickman, earn coins, unlock toys and hats, and keep a daily streak going.

Idle.name: Viral Den
Idle.pitch: Tap to film clips and watch followers climb while cash buys camera, lights, room and gear upgrades that visibly transform your streamer room across levels.

Idle.name: Liftoff Lab: Space Program for Your AI Agents
Idle.pitch: Coding agents' activity builds and fuels rockets at launch pads, then you steer each launch through rings to reach progressively farther planets.

Cards.name: Peakpatch: TriPeaks Solitaire Journey
Cards.pitch: Clear peaks of cards one higher or lower, chain streaks for wild cards and sail a stepping-stone journey across 12 cozy 3D islands.

Cards.name: Silkline: Spider Solitaire
Cards.pitch: Classic spider solitaire with 1, 2 or 4 suits: build King-to-Ace runs, deal new rows, unlimited undo.

Cards.name: Fourbay: Four Cell Solitaire
Cards.pitch: The classic four-cell patience: park cards in four free cells, build down in alternating colours and send every suit home.

Cards.name: Sandstep: Pyramid Solitaire
Cards.pitch: Classic pyramid solitaire: pair cards that add up to 13 to clear the pyramid, with three passes through the stock.

Cards.name: Heartwick: Hearts Card Game
Cards.pitch: Play Hearts against three fair computer players: pass three cards, dodge the queen of spades or shoot the moon.

Cards.name: Trumpline: Spades Card Game
Cards.pitch: Play Spades with a computer partner: bid or go nil, trump with spades, dodge bags and race to 200 or 300.

Kids.name: Beatbuds: Beat Maker Music Mix
Kids.pitch: Drag beats, effects, melodies and voices onto seven singing buds and hunt for the hidden combos.

Kids.name: Blubbo: Virtual Pet Care
Kids.pitch: Feed, wash, tuck in and dress up a squishy jelly pet, and play three mini-games together for coins.

Kids.name: Peekaboo Pals: Animal Memory Match
Kids.pitch: Peek at the animal cards, then flip them to find matching pairs on a table that grows each level, with hearts for mistakes.

Kids.name: Boop Board: Bubble Popper Fidget Game
Kids.pitch: Press or swipe across bubbles on squishy rainbow critter boards to pop them all before the sun-clock runs out, with some bubbles puffing back up.

Kids.name: Sudsy Lane: Kids Car Wash Game
Kids.pitch: Rub muddy toy trucks clean with a sponge, rinse and dry them, then add stickers, with a new vehicle each level.

Kids.name: Tinty: Pixel Color by Number
Kids.pitch: Pick a colour and drag to fill the numbered pixels of 57 cute pictures.

Makeover.name: Snip Studio: Hair Salon Makeover
Makeover.pitch: Wash, cut, dye and style a client's hair to match a reference look, with funny client requests driving each short level.

Makeover.name: Goo Lab: Slime Simulator ASMR
Makeover.pitch: Drip dyes into glue, stir to match the recipe card, then squish and poke the soft slime, with add-ins and scoring across stages.

Makeover.name: Tip Top: Nail Salon Makeover
Makeover.pitch: Fill each client's order by choosing a nail shape, filing, polishing and stamping art, then see the whole hand finished in that look.

Makeover.name: Spin Bakes: Cake Decorating Game
Makeover.pitch: Hold to pipe textured icing rings onto a spinning cake, switch colours per layer, smooth it, and shake on toppings to match each customer's order.

Retro.name: SkiFree.js
Retro.pitch: Weave a skier downhill past trees and jumps while a yeti hunts you, in a simple endless chase that rewards quick reflexes.

Retro.name: Tank War
Retro.pitch: Defend your base and destroy enemy tanks in a top-down arcade battle.

Retro.name: Asteroids
Retro.pitch: Rotate and thrust a small triangular ship through drifting vector rocks, shooting them apart while dodging fragments in a faithful, stripped-down arcade loop.
